Thanks — I've sketched the orchestration steps and simplified the fast-unpin sequence to three CLI actions plus a network gate flip. Draft excerpt below (full steps in attached runbook):

1) Guard: verify canary pods are healthy (k get pods -l canary=acme-drill)
2) Pin: set version pin on fleet (redwoodctl pin --tenant acme --version 20280615-rc3)
3) Evict: cordon + drain non-critical nodes (redwoodctl evict --label noncritical=true --grace 30s)
4) Observe: collect canary metrics for 20m with synthetic traffic ramp (neha will trigger synthetic load)
5) Fast-unpin (if abort criteria): redwoodctl unpin --tenant acme && redwoodctl rollback --to last-stable && networkctl flip-gate --target baseline

I will run a short rehearsal of the CLI steps with Aditya on Friday to confirm the commands and permissions.

Laura
Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
